paper.title: In Prospect and Retrospect: Reflective Memory Management for Long-term Personalized Dialogue Agents
paper.central_claim: Topic-organized persistent dialogue memory plus citation-reward online reranker improves personalized response and retrieval over fixed-granularity static retrieval.

signatures.feedback: New dialogue supplies updated personal information; not an externally measured execution-success write gate.

signatures.failure_boundary: Summary hallucination, conflict merging and growing maintenance; no outcome-based memory edit.
